Your Welcome Bonus, explained

How the MY99EXCH welcome bonus works, what the terms mean, and how to get the most from your first deposit.

M MY99EXCH Team1 min read

New to MY99EXCH? A welcome bonus is our way of saying hello. It gives your first deposit a little extra so you can explore more games from day one. Here's how it works – and how to read the terms so there are no surprises.

How to claim it

  1. Create your account. Registration takes a few simple steps. You must be 18 or over.
  2. Make your first deposit with UPI. Check the amount and your UPI ID before you confirm.
  3. Get your bonus. Once you're eligible, the bonus is added to your account according to the offer terms.

Understanding the bonus terms

Every bonus comes with its own terms, shown with the offer. They usually cover a few key points:

  • Eligibility – who can claim the offer, for example new players only.
  • Minimum deposit – the smallest deposit that qualifies.
  • Wagering requirements – how much you need to play before bonus funds can be withdrawn.
  • Time limits – how long the bonus stays active.

Not sure what a term means? Ask our support team before you claim – they're available 24/7 and happy to explain.

Tips to get the most from it

  • Read the offer terms before you deposit, not after.
  • Set a budget for your first session and stick to it.
  • Try a few different games – slots, live tables or Aviator – to find what you enjoy.

Play responsibly

A bonus is there to add to the fun, not to chase losses. Take regular breaks, and if gaming stops being enjoyable, reach out to our support team.
